The microStudio game engine (https://github.com/pmgl/microstudio, MIT, commit b59d904 of 30 Jun 2026) as it is exported for an HTML5 game (`runner.js`, `microengine.js`, the BitCell font), with Brython 3.11.3 (BSD 3-clause) for games written in Python. Taken from a Python project exported by a local microStudio server ("Publish > HTML5"); refresh the same way when updating. Used by `playground-microstudio/` to show example games on lesson pages (play only: students write their games on microstudio.dev).
